Author: aki
Name: Enemy Dots Melee Ring
Punchline: Shows your AoE reach and which enemies it would hit right now.
Description: Draws a ring at your feet and a circle around each enemy's hitbox, green when your circle or cone AoE would hit that enemy and red when it would not. Drawn under other plugin windows.
Changelog: - your AoE reach at your feet and each enemy's hitbox circle, green when the AoE would hit it

Author: aki
Name: Focus Signs
Punchline: Mouse and key bindings that focus and mark what you hover; nameplate signs sit neatly by the name.
Description: Shift+right-click a nameplate, unit frame or model to make it your focus target and put a sign on it, or set up your own mouse and key bindings for any sign, the next free attack sign or sign removal, with or without changing focus. Nameplate signs are shrunk and placed next to the name, in the style of Plater/NaowhUI raid icons, and follow Plate Stack's stacking.
Changelog: - focus and sign bindings, nameplate sign layout

Author: aki
Name: Hover Hotbars
Punchline: Hotbars and HUD elements stay hidden until the mouse is over them.
Description: Chosen hotbars (default 4, 7 and 10) and the Main Menu bar are shown only while the mouse is over them. Keybinds keep working while they are hidden.
Changelog: - chosen hotbars and HUD elements stay hidden until hovered

Author: aki
Name: Keep Mouse On Screen
Punchline: Keeps a copy of your cursor where you pressed while a mouse button turns the camera.
Description: While a mouse button turns the camera the game hides the cursor. This draws a copy of your current cursor, custom cursors included, at the spot you pressed until you let go. On Windows the cursor also comes back to exactly that spot.
Changelog: - a copy of your cursor stays where you pressed while a mouse button turns the camera; on Windows the cursor comes back to that spot when you let go

Author: aki
Name: Kick Tracker
Punchline: Party interrupt and stun cooldowns as compact bars.
Description: One row per party member and interrupt or off-GCD stun, with the icon, name, a thin cooldown bar and the time left. Look based on NaowhUI and EXBoss interrupt bars; job colours from DelvUI.
Changelog: - party interrupt and stun cooldown bars

Author: aki
Name: Plate Stack
Punchline: Stacks overlapping nameplates upward, Plater-style, so none cover each other.
Description: Pushes overlapping enemy nameplates up, nearest first, with a smooth glide; defaults come from the NaowhUI Plater profile. Made for DelvUI nameplates, which follow every frame; the game's own plates stack only while they stand still.
Changelog: - overlapping nameplates stack upward and glide into place

Author: aki
Name: Repair Helper
Punchline: Shows low-condition gear and repairs your selection with your own dark matter in one press.
Description: Lists gear at or below a condition threshold with the dark matter grade each self-repair needs, and repairs one item or a whole selection with your own dark matter after a confirm naming the dark matter used and left. Shows dark matter held per grade and notifications for low gear, missing dark matter, gear you can't self-repair and failed repairs; can repair automatically (off by default).
Changelog: - lists gear by condition and repairs it with your own dark matter after a confirm; notifications and optional automatic repair

Author: aki
Name: Scenario Guide Skin
Punchline: Main Scenario Guide drawn as Duty List rows, with the Duty List pinned under it.
Description: Restyles the Main Scenario Guide into plain quest-marker and title rows in the Duty List's quest-title style, hides rows the Duty List already shows, and keeps the Duty List directly under the guide.
Changelog: - Main Scenario Guide shown as Duty List rows with quest markers; rows the Duty List already lists are hidden; Duty List pinned under the guide

Author: aki
Name: Screen Note
Punchline: An editable note pinned to the screen; click it to edit in place.
Description: Shows a short note at the top left of the screen. Click it to edit, Ctrl+Enter or click away to save, Esc to cancel; the lock in its corner makes it click-through. Uses NaowhUI's Naowh font when you provide the file.
Changelog: - editable note on screen with a lock button that makes it click-through

Author: aki
Name: Target Plate Arrows
Punchline: Arrows beside your target's DelvUI nameplate bar.
Description: Draws a pair of arrows beside your hard target's DelvUI enemy nameplate bar, styled after the NaowhUI target arrows. The arrows hide with the bar as long as the plate settings match your DelvUI profile. Requires DelvUI.
Changelog: - arrows bracket your target's DelvUI enemy bar
